thread_text:
1. AI Agents Blocked by Airlines

United Airlines has permanently banned AI agents from booking flights. The system now requires direct human-verified booking.

2. Human Verification Required

Airlines are implementing strict human verification protocols for all bookings. Automated travel workflows are being shut down.

3. Paid Agents Also Denied

Even premium AI agents like ChatGPT's Operator are getting rejected. No exceptions for paid services.

4. Fallback Plan Needed

Your automated travel workflow needs a backup strategy. Without one, bookings will fail.

5. Test Your Bot Now

Test your booking bot this week or risk losing the route entirely. Does your automation still work?

instagram.caption:
You can't book a United flight through ChatGPT's Operator anymore — or any AI agent. ✈️

United has permanently blocked automated bookings and now requires a human-verified step before purchase.

That applies to paid agents too — no exceptions, no workaround.

So if your travel workflow relies on a bot to grab seats, it will fail silently until you test it. 🤖

Anyone shipping automation for clients needs a human fallback built in this week, or bookings just stop.

Have you actually tested your booking bot since this change? 🔍
